Title: Newsletter Operating System: All-in-one dashboard to launch & grow your newsletter | Product Hunt
# Newsletter Operating System. ## All-in-one dashboard to launch & grow your newsletter. Building a newsletter is not easy, but this dashboard makes it simple. Get better at writing, growing & monetizing your newsletter by using Newsletter OS. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for Newsletter Operating System. 👋 I'm really excited to share Newsletter Operating System (OS) with you. **Why did I create this?** I started writing a curated newsletter this year. From writing a simple newsletter, this soon became a juggling act of curating, writing, scheduling, growing an audience and monetizing. So I built an Operating System in Notion to manage everything I needed to build my newsletter. Now I'm making it available to help other newsletter writers save time and improve their newsletters every week. I've spent 150+ hours working on this Notion dashboard, so you don't have to spend time building it yourself. **Who is this for?** Anyone who is planning to start a newsletter, or wants to get better at running one! **What is Newsletter OS?** "It's epic! It's clear that many many hours of high-quality work have gone into it." - Kieran Ball **Why Notion?** It's a great way to get organized. does newsletterOS go into the world of paid newsletters like you can do on Ghost or Substack? It focuses more on growing, writing and managing everything. There are a ton of monetization avenues I discuss and paid newsletters is one of them, but I don't do a deep dive into how to convert people from free to paid newsletters. This product is a BEAST of a resource!! My newsletter is fairly small and I am very interested in growing it faster. Glad I'm already subscribed to your newsletter and I'm looking forward to seeing it grow further. Your are willing to launch a newsletter or simply want to get better at organizing your work around the newsletter you already run? I'm glad you like Newsletter OS. Can't wait for you to start a newsletter 😉. Newsletter OS is the best guide + dashboard for starting, writing & growing a newsletter. Janel has worked a ton on this resource to help you manage and grow your newsletter.
